knowledge_graph.title: Participation loan
knowledge_graph.description: Participation loans are loans made by multiple lenders to a single borrower. It is similar to syndicated loan but each lender passes the funds to the lead financial institution which provides the loan to the lender.

text_blocks.snippet: A participation loan, also known as loan participation or participation financing, is a lending arrangement where multiple financial institutions share the funding of a single loan. One institution, the lead lender, originates and services the loan, while other institutions, known as participants, purchase portions of the loan to share in the associated risks and returns.
